context_for_next_testing_agent: BPM Damage Checklist feature fully tested and working. Key model: DamageItem {name: str, checked: bool, cost: float}. damage_items array sent to backend as part of TaxatieCreate. Backend computes: has_damage (from checked items), herstelkosten (sum of checked item costs), schade_aftrek (herstelkosten * 0.31). Frontend has 26 DEFAULT_DAMAGE_ITEMS including: Kuipdelen, Tank, Lak, Uitlaat, Motorblok, Frame, Voorvork, Achterdemper, Remschijven, Banden, Ketting, Koppeling, Accu, Verlichting, Knipperlichten, Spiegels, Dashboard, Stuurlagers, Wiellagers, Zadel, Windscherm, Voetsteunen, Koelvloeistof, Remvloeistof, Corrosie, Overig. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_damage_checklist.py.
